scientific_integrity: The exact theorem is supported by a complete analytical proof. Finite computations are consistency checks only; literature comparisons are limited by listed source access.
scientific_limitations: One-source, one-target, exponential latent and competing-event clocks, one predetermined perfect transmission blockade; no feedback, population dynamics or policy validation. Broader historical priority remains subject to independent review.
title: A universal delayed-start law for one complete blockade in a two-stage transmission chain
